rv.q: It is ravishingly directed and choreographed by Kathleen Marshall... the whole thing oozes style and wit. Heaven.

This is a tap extravaganza to top all others, with a huge cast, many of whom were playing several different characters and, under the direction of Kathleen Marshall (also the choreographer), everyone performed some very intricate dances to absolute perfection.
The choreography is meticulous in the group numbers and the costumes sublime.
Not quite top hole, but Top Hat is topping fun if you take it on its own terms.
Overall Top Hat continues Chichester's tradition of excellent summer musicals and is a total tonic.
It is well worth a watch and a trip down to Chichester Festival Theatre to catch it during the run.
Though it is far from perfect, watching these iconic musical numbers performed with Kathleen Marshall's choreography is reason enough to give this show a whirl.
